topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 35 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token, 1 ERC721 NFT, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 15 common project-authored base contract(s) (immutablestate, peripherypayments, peripheryimmutablestate). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
